config_identity: same architecture/config across all three checkpoints by state_dict shape and same training script lineage; seed/epoch/checkpoint bytes differ

records.aggregation_behavior: virtual node uses per-graph global mean when batch is supplied; single-graph inference uses mean over nodes
records.checkpoint_selection_criterion: chain-B AUROC on 8GLA validation chain, per best_meta.json; apo false-positive metric recorded but not selection-limiting because max_apo_fp absent
records.edge_feature_behavior: 6-dimensional edge_attr used by GATv2Conv edge_dim=6 for spatial and sequential branches
historically_recorded_fields: checkpoint sha256 from best_meta.json and REPRODUCIBILITY_MANIFEST.json
records.normalization: LayerNorm in node encoder, spatial branch, sequential branch, and vnode projection
records.output_head: 5-layer MLP ending Linear(hidden/16,1) with sigmoid output
records.sequential_edge_behavior: edge_index_seq and edge_attr_seq passed to sequential GATv2 branch
records.training_split: fine-tune lineage uses 8GLA chain A supervised train labels, 8GLA chain B validation labels, 1W60 chains A/B AOH residues as explicit apo negatives; not identical to d9efd clean-split training lineage
